407:t_1:86.en:
$$マオ$$
「Still, you really went all out. It was a total massacre.」

407:t_1:87.en:
$n
「If they're a threat to the places where we live, it can't be helped.」

407:t_1:88.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Well, for a $$ビーストハンター$$ like you, I guess you'd say that.」

407:t_1:89.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Huh... So you did that kind of work too, $n?」

407:t_1:91.en:
$$ルカ$$
「$$ティティ$$... She's really settled in on the ship, hasn't she.」

407:t_1:92.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Looks like she boarded with $$エイミー$$ in the confusion of chasing after $$レド$$ and the others.」

407:t_1:93.en:
$$ティティ$$
「The fleet was fun too, but it looks like being with $c is a lot more exciting.」

407:t_1:94.en:
$$クラン$$
「Hold on a moment! You... Are you planning to just stay here like this?」

407:t_1:95.en:
$$ティティ$$
「That's fine, isn't it? I'm pretty good at housework and stuff, you know.」

407:t_1:96.en:
$$マオ$$
「True, the domestic crew is always short-handed, but...」

407:t_1:97.en:
$$クラン$$
「Is that really all right with you? Don't you have family in the fleet?」

407:t_1:98.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...My dad and my big brother died in the $$時空震動$$...」

407:t_1:100.en:
$$ティティ$$
「And then Mom went strange... and it seems like she started to hate me...」

407:t_1:102.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So I left home... because I didn't want to end up hating Mom...」

407:t_1:103.en:
$$クラン$$
「S-sorry, $$ティティ$$... I didn't know there was a story like that...」

407:t_1:104.en:
$$ティティ$$
「It's okay. I'm having fun now.」

407:t_1:106.en:
$$宗介$$
「That girl lost her parents in the $$時空震動$$ too...」

407:t_1:110.en:
$n
(The reason I feel calm when I look at that girl must be that I sensed something in her that's the same as in me...)

407:t_1:113.en:
$$シェリル$$
「It'll be fine. $$レド$$ will definitely come back.」

407:t_1:114.en:
$$エイミー$$
「But... the $$レド$$ who comes back might not be the $$レド$$ I know...」

407:t_1:116.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Nobody will tell me the details, but $$レド$$ killed a lot of $$クジライカ$$s, didn't he...」

407:t_1:118.en:
$$エイミー$$
「I tried hard to understand why $$レド$$ did something like that, but...」

407:t_1:121.en:
$$アルト$$
「He lived inside a cage called the $$人類銀河同盟$$, but now he's out of it and has become a bird that's gained its freedom.」

407:t_1:123.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's precisely because he's gained freedom that he's bewildered. His old way of living and his way of living from now on... he's thinking about how to fly, and he's lost.」

407:t_1:124.en:
$$アルト$$
「But I believe in what he was born with... his clumsy kindness.」

407:t_1:125.en:
$$宗介$$
「I agree with $$アルト$$. He's finally coming to understand that he's a human being before he's a soldier.」

407:t_1:126.en:
$n
「Right now he's probably torn between his duty as a soldier of the Alliance and his own judgment.」

407:t_1:127.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You all... watch $$レド$$ closely, don't you...」

407:t_1:128.en:
$$ランカ$$
「You do too, don't you, $$エイミー$$?」

407:t_1:130.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$エイミー$$ we all know is finally back.」

407:t_1:131.en:
$$シェリル$$
「That's a nice thing to say, $$アルト$$.」

407:t_1:133.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Been through it... You mean being a bird that gained its freedom?」

407:t_1:135.en:
$$アルト$$
(I found something to protect and the strength to live on. $$レド$$... I believe you can find your wings too.)

407:t_1:138.en:
$$マオ$$
「Quit grinning from the sidelines and step in to help $$ランカ$$, why don't you, big brother?」

407:t_1:140.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Then what are you looking at?」

407:t_1:141.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「In my memories, $$ランカ$$ is a little girl who was always clinging to my back...」

407:t_1:142.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Seeing that $$ランカ$$ worry about someone and comfort them like that makes me happy.」

407:t_1:143.en:
$$マオ$$
「...You win. You're a genuine knight.」

407:t_1:144.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Well... you've got over ten years of not seeing her to make up for, so go ahead and be as big a sis-con as you like.」

407:t_1:147.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「It's not the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, is it...」

407:t_1:148.en:
$$キャシー$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ approach confirmed. All mobile force members, prepare to sortie.」

407:t_1:149.en:
$$宗介$$
「Hitting the $$クジライカ$$ survey unit has drawn in the units around here, huh.」

407:t_1:150.en:
$$マオ$$
「If they came to us, that's convenient. We'll beat them down and make this sea quiet!」

407:t_2:3.en: ～ $$ガルガンティア船団$$, Fleet Commander's Room ～

407:t_2:4.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「...Sorry about this. Thank you for humoring my one last selfish request...」

407:t_2:6.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「In this place I... have watched over $$ガルガンティア$$ for a long time...」

407:t_2:9.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「It was the same during that storm they call the $$時空震動$$...」

407:t_2:10.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「So... I want to meet my final moment here as well.」

407:t_2:11.en:
$$リジット$$
「...A report has come in from Captain $$ジェフリー$$... that they have wiped out the $$サイデリアル$$...」

407:t_2:12.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「And what about $$フランジ$$?」

407:t_2:13.en:
$$リジット$$
「I haven't heard anything about what happened after the raid on the $$クジライカ$$ nest.」

407:t_2:15.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「$$リジット$$... From now on, you will be the one to carve out the fleet's future.」

407:t_2:17.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「You must not fear change. The sea... and the world... will change...」
